jenson-roman-typeface.description: A dim, painterly interior with a man in a dark gown and close cap standing at a wooden printing press, lifting a pale printed sheet with one hand. In the foreground a wooden tray of metal type sits on a workbench beside a steel tool and dark ink balls, with a lit candle at the left edge. Heavy beams overhead and stacked paper on a side table complete the room. The image fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible border.

caxton-westminster-press.description: An oil-painted interior of a timber-and-stone workshop. A man in a dark fur-trimmed coat and black beret holds a printed sheet by a leaded window. Beside a large wooden screw press, a young worker in an apron inks type with two leather balls. Another man works at the far right, and printed sheets hang on cords from the rafters. Type cases and stacked paper sit on shelves. The look is late medieval or early modern.

garamond-roman-type.description: An elderly man with grey hair and a leather apron leans over a wooden workbench, holding a brass-rimmed magnifying glass to his eye while he works on a small steel piece in a vise. Rows of small steel punches stand in wooden racks, with small copper blocks, a hammer and files on the bench. A forge pot with glowing coals, a lit candle and stacked old books sit in a dim, warm workshop. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no text or border.

bay-psalm-book.description: A man in dark 17th-century style clothing and a white collar leans into the wooden bar of a large timber screw printing press in a dim, beamed workshop. Printed sheets hang on a line overhead, and ink balls and loose pages sit on a bench in the foreground. A snowy half-timbered street shows through a leaded window on the right.

caslon-type-specimen.description: A man in a powdered wig, dark waistcoat and rolled white shirt stands in a dim workshop, holding up a long sheet of paper printed with rows of alphabet samples in graduated sizes. A workbench in front holds a wooden type tray filled with metal letters, a hand mould, and small tools, and a fireplace glows at right. The scene is oil-painting style with warm, dark tones and no border.

baskerville-virgil.description: An elderly man with grey hair in a wig and a dark buttoned coat leans over an open book on a wooden table. Behind him is a wooden screw printing press, with stacks of paper on a bench and a window light in the dim workshop. Small printed lines are visible on the open page, and there are black ink balls on the table.

first-sans-serif-typeface.description: A man with dark, tousled hair and a grey waistcoat over a rolled-sleeve white shirt holds up a metal block with raised, mirrored letters, looking startled. Behind him is a workshop with a brick fireplace glowing with fire, and a bench with a tray of metal type, ladles, crumpled paper and tools. The painting is a dark oil style and runs edge to edge with no frame visible.

sholes-typewriter-patent.description: A bearded man in a grey waistcoat and rolled sleeves leans over a dark wooden machine with a circular ring of metal typebars and a row of pale keys at its front. A sheet of paper sits in a carriage at the top left. Behind him is a cluttered workshop with a vise, hand tools on the walls and bench, a cloth, and a dim window.

remington-typewriter-sales.description: A painted interior in an oil-painting style. A man in a dark frock coat and bow tie leans over a black ornate typewriter with floral gold decoration, set on a wooden table with a cast-iron treadle-style base. A younger man in a waistcoat and rolled sleeves watches closely beside him. Behind them are a lit oil lamp, shelves of tools, rifles mounted on a wall, a window, and a horse-drawn carriage visible outside. No visible text, no frame; the painting fills the image edge to edge.

johnston-london-typeface.description: A man in a dark waistcoat and white shirt sits on a wooden chair at a slanted drafting desk in a dim room, drawing angular black letters with a pen on a large sheet of paper. Ink pots and a pen sit on the desk ledge, and books and rolled papers are on shelves behind him. On the right, a white board with a red ring and dark horizontal bar, like a transport roundel, leans against the wall beside posters of more lettering. Window light comes from the left, and the scene is painted in a dark oil style.

futura-typeface-released.description: A painted interior of a dim room with a slanted drafting table in the foreground. On the pale paper sheet are a drawn circle with overlapping ellipse loops, straight construction lines forming a triangle and cross axes, a metal compass, a metal set square and a wooden ruler. A window with small panes is at the upper left, and a tubular-frame chair sits in the dark background. No people, no visible letters or text, and no frame.

times-new-roman-debut.description: A man in a dark workshop, in a rolled-sleeve shirt and leather apron, leans over a metal tray holding a printing forme of tiny dense text blocks. Behind him is a large old cast-iron printing press with a crank wheel, lit by a hanging lamp. A cart of stacked printed sheets sits to the right. The style is an oil painting with warm, low light.

helvetica-released.description: An oil-style painting of a man in a white shirt and dark tie bent over a table, arranging large dark cut-out letters on a white sheet under a hanging lamp. Posters with letter grids hang on the dark wall, with scissors, a ruler and paper scraps on the table. The painting runs edge to edge with no visible frame. The shirt, tie and hairstyle suggest mid-20th century.

ibm-selectric-typewriter.description: A painted, dimly lit study. Two adult hands, in a patterned dark sleeve, hold small silver spherical objects covered in tiny raised dots, one lifted above a grey metal typewriter with a round black knob on its front. Papers sit in a wooden tray to the right, a desk lamp and stacked folders are behind, and a window with curtains is at the upper right. No visible text, frame or wall edge; the painting runs to all four edges.

project-gutenberg-begins.description: A dark, painterly interior lit by a single desk lamp. In the center is a beige office machine, a keyboard-and-carriage unit with a long strip of perforated paper that spills onto the floor in folds. Behind it are a reel-to-reel tape recorder and a stack of reels, and at left are shelves of small cards or folders. The image fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible border.

desktop-publishing-arrives.description: An oil-painting style scene of a cluttered desk in a dim room under a lamp. A beige all-in-one computer with a small screen shows a page layout with text columns and image boxes. Beside it, a beige laser-style printer is feeding out a newspaper-style page with photos. Floppy disks, a coffee mug, a keyboard, a mouse and a ruler sit on the wood desk. Grey cubicle partitions fill the background, and a sheet of paper on the left wall has illegible marks.

comic-sans-created.reason: Legible text is painted on the screen: the menu bar (File Edit View Format Help), OK and Cancel buttons, a Start button and an 8:35 AM clock, plus lettering in the balloons and comic panels. Repaint the screen with blank interface shapes and no writing.
comic-sans-created.description: A painted beige CRT computer on a dark desk. The screen shows a software window with a cartoon dog and a speech balloon, a thumbnail strip, and a small warning dialog. Around it lie pen-inked comic pages, an ink bottle, a dip pen and brushes. The painting fills the frame, with no people or border. The screen has a menu bar reading File Edit View Format Help, OK and Cancel buttons, a Start button and an 8:35 AM clock, and the comic panels have lettering.

emoji-added-to-unicode.description: A painterly night street scene in a busy city, with neon signs and red lanterns in the background and blurred pedestrians in dark clothing. In the foreground, a hand holds a black smartphone whose screen shows a grid of cartoon icons: smiley faces, hearts, a sun, a cat, and a flower. The image fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible frame or border.
